Who you'll deal with

Meet Brodie & Jordan

BPMH.mowing is a small local business run by Brodie (the boss) and Jordan (co-boss), with Broxii the crew dog. When you call, you talk to the people who actually turn up and do the job.

Brodie started the business with one lesson from his grandpa, a Vietnam veteran: care means everything. That's how we treat every yard, and every customer.

Older residents, veterans, people with disability and NDIS participants are all welcome. So is anyone who just needs a hand keeping on top of the yard.
